topic.title: What Do CS2 Cheat Features Actually Do?

evidence.heading: Aimbot
evidence.excerpt: The product memory documents FOV, Smooth, priorities, weapon profiles, hitboxes, and checks at a high level.

evidence.heading: TriggerBot
evidence.excerpt: The product memory separates shot-timing controls from assisted aim movement.

evidence.heading: ESP and Hub
evidence.excerpt: The memory lists Box, Skeleton, Chams, health, weapons, status indicators, bomb utilities, spectator list, and keybinds.
